blind.description: A stylized bird's nest constructed of intertwined dark brown twigs and branches, lined along the inner rim with fresh green leaves or moss. Nestled inside the cup are three pale speckled tan/beige bird eggs. The geometry is solid and continuous with stylized low-to-mid poly meshes, sitting directly on the ground without a plinth or pedestal.
blind.from_above: A circular brown twig wreath surrounding green leafy bedding, with three speckled eggs clustered together in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 6 to 8 inches tall (roughly 1/10 the height of the figure) and approximately 1.2 to 1.5 feet in diameter.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
